text: If the zombie apocalypse starts on a cruise ship, and the whole ship heard you start the engines...
they're coming up to the bridge. All of them.
Rule one. Use the fire hoses, not weapons.
Water pushes back a whole crowd. A bat only stops one.
Rule two. Seal the decks behind you.
Every door you close is one less way up.
Rule three. Abandon ship only when you can see land.
Out here, a lifeboat is just a smaller ship.
So you lower the lifeboat. Together, this time.
But every single light is out.
